description:
This process begins when a customer searches for a flight, train, or bus ticket.
After selecting the preferred route, date, and time, the customer provides personal information and payment details.
The booking system generates a ticket, which is sent to the customer via email or SMS.
The travel company updates its seat inventory accordingly.
Before travel, the customer may receive reminders and instructions for check-in or boarding.
The process concludes once the customer completes their journey, though post-travel feedback or services may extend it slightly.

<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" id="Definitions_TravelTicketBooking" targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/travel-ticket-booking">

    <bpmn:userTask id="UT_SelectDate" name="Select date">

    </bpmn:userTask>

    <bpmn:userTask id="UT_SelectTime" name="Select time">
      <bpmn:incoming>CF_04</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>CF_05</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>

    <bpmn:userTask id="UT_ProvidePersonalInfo" name="Provide personal information">
      <bpmn:incoming>CF_05</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>CF_06</bpmn:outgoing>

      <bpmn:incoming>CF_08</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>CF_09</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:manualTask>

      <bpmn:outgoing>CF_14</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_ReminderReceived" messageRef="Msg_Reminder"/>
    </bpmn:boundaryEvent>

    <bpmn:manualTask id="MT_ReadReminder" name="Read reminder and instructions">
      <bpmn:incoming>CF_14</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>CF_15</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:manualTask>

    <bpmn:endEvent id="EE_ReminderRead" name="Reminder and instructions received">
      <bpmn:incoming>CF_15</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="GW_CustFeedbackSplit" name="Feedback given" default="CF_11">
      <bpmn:incoming>CF_09</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>CF_10</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>CF_11</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:userTask id="UT_GiveFeedback" name="Give post-travel feedback">
      <bpmn:incoming>CF_10</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>CF_12</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>

      <bpmn:incoming>CF_11</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>CF_12</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>CF_13</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:endEvent id="EE_CustomerDone" name="Journey completed">
      <bpmn:incoming>CF_13</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="CF_01" sourceRef="StartEvent_CustomerSearch" targetRef="UT_SearchTicket"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="CF_03" sourceRef="UT_SelectRoute" targetRef="UT_SelectDate"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="CF_06" sourceRef="UT_ProvidePersonalInfo" targetRef="UT_ProvidePaymentDetails"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="CF_07" sourceRef="UT_ProvidePaymentDetails" targetRef="CE_TicketReceived"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="CF_08" sourceRef="CE_TicketReceived" targetRef="MT_CompleteJourney"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="CF_09" sourceRef="MT_CompleteJourney" targetRef="GW_CustFeedbackSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="CF_10" name="Feedback given" sourceRef="GW_CustFeedbackSplit" targetRef="UT_GiveFeedback">

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="CF_11" name="No feedback" sourceRef="GW_CustFeedbackSplit" targetRef="GW_CustFeedbackMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="CF_12" sourceRef="UT_GiveFeedback" targetRef="GW_CustFeedbackMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="CF_13" sourceRef="GW_CustFeedbackMerge" targetRef="EE_CustomerDone"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="CF_14" sourceRef="BE_ReminderReceived" targetRef="MT_ReadReminder"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="CF_15" sourceRef="MT_ReadReminder" targetRef="EE_ReminderRead"/>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_TravelCompany" name="Travel Company Ticket Booking" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_SearchReceived" name="Ticket search received">
      <bpmn:outgoing>TF_01</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_SearchReceived" messageRef="Msg_SearchRequest"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>

    <bpmn:receiveTask id="RT_ReceiveSelection" name="Receive route, date and time selection" messageRef="Msg_RouteSelection">

      <bpmn:outgoing>TF_11</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="GW_ChannelMerge" name="Ticket dispatched">

      <bpmn:outgoing>TF_12</bpmn:outgoing>

      <bpmn:incoming>TF_07</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>TF_13</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:serviceTask>

      <bpmn:incoming>TF_12</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>TF_13</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>TF_14</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:parallelGateway>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="GW_ReminderSplit" name="Reminders applicable" default="TF_17">
      <bpmn:incoming>TF_14</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>TF_15</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>TF_17</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:sendTask id="SND_Reminder" name="Send reminders and check-in or boarding instructions" messageRef="Msg_Reminder">
      <bpmn:incoming>TF_15</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>TF_16</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="GW_ReminderMerge" name="Before travel">
      <bpmn:incoming>TF_16</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>TF_17</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>TF_18</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="CC_JourneyCompleted" name="Journey completed">
      <bpmn:incoming>TF_18</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>TF_19</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_JourneyCompleted" messageRef="Msg_JourneyCompleted"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="GW_FeedbackSplit" name="Post-travel feedback given" default="TF_22">
      <bpmn:incoming>TF_19</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>TF_20</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>TF_22</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:receiveTask id="RT_ReceiveFeedback" name="Receive post-travel feedback" messageRef="Msg_Feedback">
      <bpmn:incoming>TF_20</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>TF_21</bpmn:outgoing>

      <bpmn:outgoing>TF_23</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:endEvent id="EE_ProcessConcluded" name="Process concluded">
      <bpmn:incoming>TF_23</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="TF_01" sourceRef="StartEvent_SearchReceived" targetRef="RT_ReceiveSelection"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="TF_02" sourceRef="RT_ReceiveSelection" targetRef="RT_ReceivePersonalInfo"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="TF_04" sourceRef="RT_ReceivePaymentDetails" targetRef="ST_GenerateTicket"/>

      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${channel == 'email'}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="TF_09" name="Otherwise SMS" sourceRef="GW_ChannelSplit" targetRef="SND_TicketSMS"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="TF_10" sourceRef="SND_TicketEmail" targetRef="GW_ChannelMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="TF_11" sourceRef="SND_TicketSMS" targetRef="GW_ChannelMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="TF_12" sourceRef="GW_ChannelMerge" targetRef="GW_DispatchJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="TF_13" sourceRef="ST_UpdateSeatInventory" targetRef="GW_DispatchJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="TF_14" sourceRef="GW_DispatchJoin" targetRef="GW_ReminderSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="TF_15" name="Reminders applicable" sourceRef="GW_ReminderSplit" targetRef="SND_Reminder">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${reminderApplicable == true}</bpmn:conditionExpression>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="TF_18" sourceRef="GW_ReminderMerge" targetRef="CC_JourneyCompleted"/>

      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${feedbackProvided == true}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="TF_21" sourceRef="RT_ReceiveFeedback" targetRef="GW_FeedbackMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="TF_22" name="No feedback" sourceRef="GW_FeedbackSplit" targetRef="GW_FeedbackMerge"/>

  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
